The '''Jedi Starfighter Corps''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was staffed by [[Jedi ace]]s.

==History==
Created by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to combat the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the corps saw a major expansion during the [[New Sith Wars]] as a way to counter the fleets of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Piloting [[Redshift]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] throughout the war as part of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], the Army was dissolved as part of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and the Corps returned to its smaller form. Upgrading to the [[Savage Star fighter]]s, the Corps maintained a much smaller fleet, and over the years eventually phased out much of its armed craft.<ref name="TJP" />

[[File:TanoAndOffeeLeadASquadron.png|thumb|left|260px|[[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]] served as one of the Jedi Order's primary starfighters during campaigns of the Clone Wars.]]
Centuries later, the Order updated their Starfighter fleet with the [[Delta-6 Sprite-class starfighter|Delta-6 starfighter]] model. Used for recon missions, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Clee Rhara]] proposed to build a new starfighter facility on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]]. However, Rhara's plans were foiled by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vox Chun]] who opposed the Order's move to re-militarize.<ref name="JASE">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: Deceptions]]''</ref> 

Yet this would not be a lasting trend as the Jedi Order purchased a fleet of [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] to counter the rising violence on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Hnn-New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Starfighter Corps became a part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], eventually upgrading once more, this time to the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]]. At the conclusion of the war, the Jedi Order was disbanded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], its members hunted down and killed during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="ROTS" />
